The same applies to related parameters like `mirostat_eta` and `mirostat_tau` when Mirostat is disabled.\n\nTo fix this, the parameter-building logic in LangFlow's Ollama integration (specifically the `build_model` method) should only include `mirostat`, `mirostat_eta`, and `mirostat_tau` when Mirostat is enabled (i.e., not \"Disabled\" or 0).
